text_block_list.text:
It was the final day of summer camp.
T.M. Opera O stood upon the sandy beach—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha, a true and grand victory!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: One could say this summer was truly a victory summer for me!
...For some reason, she was looking utterly triumphant.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-kun, why the puzzled look?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You don't seem to understand why I am in such high spirits.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The reason I'm in such a good mood is...
because this summer, I achieved one enormously huge result.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What do you think it was?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That certainly happened. In particular, her growth during training with the previous generation was remarkable.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yet there was something even greater than her growth.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that would be...
"information," my friend, "information."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying her to training, I was able to witness
and confirm the true strength of the previous generation firsthand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Spe's hidden strength, Grass's brilliance.
I've seen every detail of it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before my all-seeing "Overlord Eyes,"
their abilities are practically laid bare!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How will they act on the stage of their
upcoming showdown? The picture in her mind
was already crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"It's your loss, Spe-kun, Grass-kun!
The previous generation is already dancing in the palm of my hand.
Hwahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I wasn't there, so I have no idea!
Bwahahaha!"

...It seems she doesn't care much
for the minor details.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In any case, preparations are now complete.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us return to the academyand make our next move toward the Arima Kinen.

This year's Arima Kinen, serving as the first
pivotal showdown against the Senior Class...

Four months remaining. Together with T.M. Opera O,
I shall blaze the trail of supremacy.
